W11_SCENES.title: The second watch
lines: Kira Venn: The docking ring is quiet.
Tor Saalen: Quiet is when the wounded finally sleep.
Kira Venn: Then I can take the next watch.
Tor Saalen: I will bring you caf.

choices.label: Let Kira and Tor share the watch
Ask Kira and Tor to shorten the watch

W11_SCENES.title: A map with names
lines: Sgt. Rhal Dax: I marked the routes in red.
Ilsa Myr: Mark the people who know them too.
Sgt. Rhal Dax: Routes change.
Ilsa Myr: People remember who came back.

choices.label: Put Rhal and Ilsa’s names on the map
Let Rhal and Ilsa mark routes only

W11_SCENES.title: Three ways home
lines: Kira Venn: One exit is blocked.
Sgt. Rhal Dax: I can open a service hatch.
Doc Bren: I can carry the wounded through it.
Kira Venn: Then we stay together.

choices.label: Keep Kira, Rhal, and Bren together
Send Kira, Rhal, and Bren separately

W11_SCENES.title: The treatment list
lines: Tor Saalen: I wrote down every prisoner we treated.
Doc Bren: Even the one who threatened you?
Tor Saalen: Especially that one.
Doc Bren: Then I will keep a copy.

choices.label: Let Tor and Bren treat every prisoner
Limit Tor and Bren to urgent cases

W11_SCENES.title: Landing lights
lines: Lord Ressa Vaun: The beacon is still burning.
Kell Darrow: It has a keeper.
Lord Ressa Vaun: Give the keeper relief before dawn.
Kell Darrow: I already sent two.

choices.label: Give Ressa and Kell relief before dawn
Keep Ressa and Kell at the beacon

W11_SCENES.title: Ravine count
lines: Sgt. Bo Hallan: We brought seven out.
Mira Tesk: I counted eight.
Sgt. Bo Hallan: The eighth was carrying me.
Mira Tesk: Put their name first.

choices.label: Record Bo and Mira’s eighth survivor
File Bo and Mira’s first count

W11_SCENES.title: The unsent letter
lines: Lord Ressa Vaun: I have not written to the families.
Sgt. Bo Hallan: I can sit with you.
Doc Ilo Venn: I can bring the names.
Lord Ressa Vaun: Bring them both.

choices.label: Help Ressa, Bo, and Ilo write the families
Ask Ressa, Bo, and Ilo to wait

W11_SCENES.title: Before the caves
lines: Kell Darrow: The prisoners know a way in.
Rusk Abernath: They ask safe passage out.
Kell Darrow: Give them my word.
Rusk Abernath: I will hold you to it.

choices.label: Honor Kell and Rusk’s safe passage
Have Kell and Rusk take the shortcut

W11_SCENES.title: The frontier lamp
lines: Knight Sava Orrin: Starlight has gone dark twice.
Tem Ruhl: I can hear its crew in the Force.
Knight Sava Orrin: Then we send help before the third time.
Tem Ruhl: I will go with them.

choices.label: Send Sava and Tem to the lamp
Ask Sava and Tem to hold position

W11_SCENES.title: A path on paper
lines: Sgt. Dace Morrow: This route ends in empty space.
Kiri Vass: A Path does not care what the chart says.
Sgt. Dace Morrow: Can we follow it?
Kiri Vass: Only if we trust each other.

choices.label: Trust Dace and Kiri’s uncertain route
Keep Dace and Kiri on mapped ground

W11_SCENES.title: After the alarm
lines: Knight Sava Orrin: The alarm stopped.
Doc Halden Pree: The patients have not.
Bruk Tannar: I can move the beds.
Knight Sava Orrin: I will clear the corridor.

choices.label: Clear beds with Sava, Halden, and Bruk
Move Sava, Halden, and Bruk ahead

W11_SCENES.title: A name for fear
lines: Tem Ruhl: The empty place frightened me.
Kiri Vass: Say that again when we report.
Tem Ruhl: They will call it weakness.
Kiri Vass: Then they can hear it from both of us.

choices.label: Let Tem and Kiri name their fear
Ask Tem and Kiri for a quieter report

W11_SCENES.title: The watch after
lines: Kira Venn: I marked every shuttle that came back.
Tor Saalen: You missed the one we were on.
Kira Venn: I knew you would bring it in.
Tor Saalen: Then take the next watch with me.

choices.label: Take Kira and Tor’s next watch together
Give Kira and Tor separate watches

W11_SCENES.title: Names on the route
lines: Sgt. Rhal Dax: The red route held.
Ilsa Myr: Three names were left beside it.
Sgt. Rhal Dax: Keep them on the map.
Ilsa Myr: I already have.

choices.label: Keep Rhal and Ilsa’s missing names
Close Rhal and Ilsa’s route report
